Not necessarily. Hansen reports **tree-cover loss during 2020**, while JRC reports **forest cover in its 2020 reference**. An area could have lost tree cover during the year and not appear as forest in the reference. The products also use different definitions and methods: tree cover is not necessarily classified as forest.

The figures alone do not establish whether the datasets disagree on the same pixels or why JRC mapped no forest. Hansen’s 67.7 ha is historical loss before the 31 December 2020 baseline, not a post-baseline event.
